description: React component for managing reporting attribute mappings associated with an asset. Includes functions for loading, creating, editing, and saving mappings, as well as rendering a data table and modal form.

methods.name: buildProgramIndex
methods.description: Builds a map from reportingProgramId to ReportingProgramMasterDto for quick lookup.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the reporting attribute mappings data from the server.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes form to create a new reporting attribute mapping and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Populates the form with existing mapping data for editing and opens the modal dialog.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form data and submits it to create or update a reporting attribute mapping.
